title: Respawn Beacon
description: This plugin adds a custom beacon that when placed sets your respawn point to the center of it. When broken the spawn point gets removed (useful for genraid servers).
body: **RespawnBeacon** is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds custom respawn points to your server. Place a specially crafted beacon to set your spawn — die, and you'll wake up right where you left it. Your beacon stays yours until it's broken, at which point both you and the breaker are notified. Simple, clean, and zero configuration required.
